description: Get the answer to a question started with anyforge_ask_oracle that came back with status "running". Waits up to ~40s per call. Status "done" carries the answer; "running" means call this again with the same askId (it never re-runs the question; a "leg" above 1 means the server is continuing a turn that ran out of time). An error means the turn failed or the askId is unknown/expired (asks are kept for a day).
name: anyforge_get_oracle_answer
title: Get oracle answer
